main.title: Costs and Financing for International Students | University of Bonn
quotes: The University of Bonn does not charge tuition fees.
Living expenses for a student in Bonn amount to roughly €1,000 a month and will mainly go on your rent.

fees.title: Applications from International Students | University of Bonn
quotes: Public universities in Germany do not charge tuition fees, only semester fees. At the University of Bonn, these are around EUR 300 per semester (EUR 600 per year).
